forcedAssumptions: LJMB current-core airspace membership is projected from explicit low-level point-to-volume assignment over worked boundary geometry. This remains a 2D plan-view approximation, not altitude-aware polygon reasoning.
Apron and stand access now use the authored working-DXF ground graph and authored stand points.
Current-core holding points are attached to whichever taxiway paths already contain the authored holding-point geometry. This remains a path-level assignment, not a richer runway-entry area model.
5 projected LJMB point(s) still fall outside the worked low-level CTR/TMA slice and are temporarily assigned to an explicit open-FIR Class G fallback volume.

LJMB runtime SID projection compiles leading fixless climb legs as runway-threshold waypoints where necessary, because the current SID model is waypoint-based rather than path-terminator based.
omittedFeatures: Only runtime-usable classed low-level airspace volumes are projected into the current candidate; boundary-only/special-use geometry and altitude-aware membership still remain outside the current-core subset.
LJMB mixed boundary-crossing VFR routes still omit route airspace profiles unless they can be assigned honestly under the InVolume / InClass / Segmented model.
LJMB richer IFR publication variants remain outside the current-core subset where the runtime model still collapses them to a single selected minima/profile path.
projectionGaps: LJMB operational sectors are not yet structured, even though a first candidate working-airspace set is now available.

Taxiway names are currently inferred from the nearest apt.dat route edges and should be confirmed explicitly later.

advisories.contact: Two-way radio communication required. Contact Maribor Tower 5 MIN prior to reaching the first REP.
advisories.reporting: Primary Maribor CTR REPs shown on the current Jepp terminal VFR chart include OSMOT, LAPNA, MN1, MN2, ME2, MS1, IRLIX, ME1, and MIRSO.
advisories.route: Enter CTR Maribor via REPs and routes as depicted.

advisories.availability: Check operating hours for Maribor Approach.
advisories.contact: Before entering TMA Maribor 1&2 contact Maribor Approach. If no reply, contact Ljubljana Approach or Ljubljana Information.
advisories.general: VFR flights entering via these entry points shall as soon as practicable establish radio contact with Maribor Approach.
advisories.route: Enter TMA Maribor 1&2 via entry points GOLVA, MUREG, PETOV, OBUTI, NIDLO, TISKO, DIMLO, MS2, MS3, ME3, ME4, MW1.
